data_description.client_cert: Path to the PSD2 certificate PEM file on the Home Assistant host.
data_description.client_key: Path to the matching private key PEM file.
data_description.sandbox: Use the Air Bank sandbox instead of production.

direct.description: Direct Air Bank Open API for an application that already has an account-information licence. Register {redirect_uri} as the redirect URI. Payments cannot be sent from Home Assistant.
direct.title: Air Bank certificate

data_description.account_names:
One account on each line. The number and the name are separated by an equals sign, not by a space.
1234567890=Main account
9999999999=Savings account
data_description.folder_airbank: Mailbox folder or Gmail label for Air Bank notices. Each bank has its own folder.
data_description.folder_csas: Mailbox folder or Gmail label for Česká spořitelna notices. A received payment in this folder is read.
data_description.folder_mbank: Mailbox folder or Gmail label for the daily mBank E-mail Push summary.
data_description.mark_seen: After a notice is imported, mark that message read. Mail that could not be parsed stays unread.
data_description.imap_host: For Gmail this is imap.gmail.com. Use an app password when the provider requires one.
data_description.imap_password: Stored on this Home Assistant host and used only to read mail.

email.description: Read the latest incoming and outgoing payment from Air Bank emails in your own mailbox. In Air Bank internet banking, open Účty a karty, the account, Možnosti, Info o dění na účtu, and send balance changes by email to this mailbox. Each notice states the available balance after the change. The booked balance is not in the mail, so that sensor stays empty. Notices are summed for the current year and the current month, each as incoming, outgoing, and net. Payments cannot be sent from Home Assistant.
email.title: Email notices

data_description.account_names:
One account on each line. The number and the name are separated by an equals sign, not by a space.
1234567890=Main account
9999999999=Savings account
data_description.folder_airbank: Mailbox folder or Gmail label for Air Bank notices. Each bank has its own folder.
data_description.folder_csas: Mailbox folder or Gmail label for Česká spořitelna notices. A received payment in this folder is read.
data_description.folder_mbank: Mailbox folder or Gmail label for the daily mBank E-mail Push summary.
data_description.mark_seen: After a notice is imported, mark that message read. Mail that could not be parsed stays unread.

email_reauth_confirm.description: The mailbox rejected the saved password. Enter it again. Home Assistant keeps reading the same mailbox.
email_reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect the mailbox

data_description.application_id: Application ID from the Enable Banking control panel.
data_description.client_key: Path to this application's private key PEM file on the Home Assistant host.
data_description.country: Two-letter country of the bank, for example CZ.
data_description.psu_type: Personal covers a private account. Business covers a company account.

enable_banking.description: Use your own Enable Banking application. Register {redirect_uri} as an allowed redirect URL. The next step lists the banks available in the country you enter. In production, whitelist only your own accounts. Sandbox or production is chosen when the application is created. Payments cannot be sent from Home Assistant.
enable_banking.title: Enable Banking

enable_bank.description: Choose the bank in {country}. Only balances and transactions are read. Payments cannot be sent from Home Assistant.
enable_bank.title: Choose the bank

enable_consent.description: Sign in at the selected bank through Enable Banking.
enable_consent.title: Sign in at the bank

enable_reauth_confirm.description: Sign in again at the selected bank through Enable Banking. The application redirect URL must be {redirect_uri}.
enable_reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Enable Banking

reauth_confirm.description: Sign in again at Air Bank. The application redirect URI must be {redirect_uri}.
reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Air Bank

user.description: Choose email notices, Enable Banking, or a bank's own API. Under the bank API, Air Bank uses a licensed certificate, Česká spořitelna uses an application from the Erste developer portal, and Fio uses a watch-only token from its internet banking. Payments cannot be sent from Home Assistant.
user.title: Connect a bank

bank_api.description: Choose the bank. Each bank uses its own application or token, stored only on this Home Assistant. Payments cannot be sent from Home Assistant.
bank_api.title: Bank API

data_description.client_id: Client ID of your Česká spořitelna application.
data_description.client_secret: Client secret of that application. Stored on this Home Assistant host.
data_description.sandbox: Use the Erste sandbox instead of production. Sandbox accounts are test data.
data_description.web_api_key: Web API key from the same application.

csas.description: Use your own application from the Erste developer portal, with Accounts API and the siblings.accounts scope. Register {redirect_uri} as the redirect URI. Production has to be approved by Česká spořitelna. For a personal account the bank does not charge the Premium API fee. Payments cannot be sent from Home Assistant.
csas.title: Česká spořitelna

csas_consent.description: Sign in at George and allow this application to read payment accounts.
csas_consent.title: Sign in at Česká spořitelna

csas_reauth_confirm.description: Sign in again at George. The application redirect URI must be {redirect_uri}.
csas_reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Česká spořitelna

data_description.fio_token: Watch-only token from Fio internet banking. Stored on this Home Assistant host.

fio.description: In Fio internet banking open Settings, then API. Create a token with account watching only, not payment entry. The token belongs to one account and starts working five minutes after you authorize it. Home Assistant reads movements and the closing balance for at most the last 90 days. It does not send payments.
fio.title: Fio banka

data_description.large_payment: Announce a payment only when its amount is at least this number. Leave it empty to announce every new payment.
data_description.low_balance: Announce once when the available balance falls below this number. It can announce again after the balance rises above it. Leave it empty to turn this off.

init.description: These alerts are optional. The payment event is still fired for every new payment.
init.title: Alerts

get_dashboard.name: Get dashboard
get_dashboard.description: Return the dashboard configuration for the current accounts as YAML. Paste it into a dashboard yourself. This action does not change any dashboard.

dashboard_missing_cards.title: The HA Banking dashboard needs cards
dashboard_missing_cards.description: Install {cards} from HACS or the Home Assistant Marketplace, then reload the page. This integration does not install cards.
